Programs

Energy & water programs we work with

Programs can help make efficiency upgrades more accessible. Here is an overview of the programs Justice Energy Co. works with, the services they relate to and how to ask about them.

Ask about a program (866) 504-8989

Incentive amounts, eligibility and funding availability are determined by each program and can change. They are not guaranteed. We will review current program information with you before you commit to any work.

SoCalRENSouthern California Regional Energy Network

The Southern California Regional Energy Network is a public-agency-led network that offers energy-efficiency programs and resources across Southern California. We can help you understand which offerings may apply to your upgrade.

SoCal WaterSmart

SoCal WaterSmart offers resources and rebates for water-saving devices and turf replacement in participating Southern California water service areas. Some offerings require approval before work begins, so talk with us before you start.

Related services
  • Turf Replacement
  • Water Conservation
Ask about SoCal WaterSmart

TECH Clean California

TECH Clean California is a statewide initiative that supports the adoption of heat pump technology for space and water heating. We can explain how heat pump upgrades may fit within the program.

How it works

How we help with programs

  1. Tell us your goals

    Share the upgrade you are considering and where your property is located.

  2. Review program fit

    We point out programs that may apply and what they typically require.

  3. Confirm before work

    Some programs require approval before work starts. We confirm the steps first.

  4. Complete the upgrade

    We complete the installation and help with the documentation we are responsible for.

Request a consultation

Have a question about a program?

Tell us about your property and the upgrades you have in mind. We will follow up to talk through options, next steps and programs that may apply.
